title: Anambra Police Command Launches Manhunt For Teacher Who Allegedly Flogged 12-Year-Old Boy To Death
desc: The Anambra State Police Command has launched a manhunt for a teacher accused of flogging a 12-year-old pupil to death at a school in Adazi-Ani, Anaocha Local Government Area of the state. The police said the search is being coordinated under the Command's Safe School Initiative Operations, led by the Assistant Commissioner of Police in charge of Operations, Harrison Oruruo.
